# Agent instructions

This repository is a curated list of Obsidian-compatible vaults and resources.

## Before working

- Read [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](CONTRIBUTING.md), [`TAXONOMY.md`](TAXONOMY.md),
  [`data/README.md`](data/README.md), and `docs/agent/HANDOFF.md`.
- Preserve unrelated work and check Git status before editing.

## Source of truth and generated files

- `data/categories.json` is the canonical taxonomy for vault and resource
  categories. `data/vaults.json`, `data/resources.json`, and
  `data/showcases.json` contain the entries.
- `README.md` and `TAXONOMY.md` are generated by
  `node scripts/build-readme.mjs`; never hand-edit generated sections/files.
- After changing data or taxonomy, run the generator and then
  `node scripts/build-readme.mjs --check`.
- Keep category changes, entry recategorizations, generated output, and
  contributor guidance in sync.

## Scope

Do not change upstream repositories, publish releases, or submit remote
changes unless the user explicitly asks.
